# harness_platform_login_settings (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving the login settings of a Harness account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harness_platform_login_settings" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `password_expiration_policy` (List of Object) Password expiration policy of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--password_expiration_policy))
- `password_strength_policy` (List of Object) Password strength policy of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--password_strength_policy))
- `user_lockout_policy` (List of Object) User lockout policy of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_lockout_policy))

<a id="nestedatt--password_expiration_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `password_expiration_policy`

Read-Only:

- `days_before_password_expires` (Number)
- `days_before_user_notified_of_password_expiration` (Number)
- `enabled` (Boolean)


<a id="nestedatt--password_strength_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `password_strength_policy`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `min_number_of_characters` (Number)
- `min_number_of_digits` (Number)
- `min_number_of_lowercase_characters` (Number)
- `min_number_of_special_characters` (Number)
- `min_number_of_uppercase_characters` (Number)
